question: Should phase one allow archiving a Gateway-local not-loaded Codex source after fresh process-local checks and explicit no-other-runner confirmation, without a cross-process lease?
rationale: Direct Codex source inspection confirms NotLoaded does not establish global inactivity, so code review cannot decide whether informed operator confirmation is an acceptable permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept confirmed local archive
options.body: Ship the documented branch-and-archive boundary, keeping paired nodes read-only and requiring the existing fresh checks plus explicit confirmation.

options.title: Ship branch-only
options.body: Keep safe local snapshot branching but remove archive until runner ownership can be fenced across Codex processes.

options.title: Remain read-only
options.body: Defer both mutation paths and retain the existing federated catalog until a duplex runner and lease design is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept confirmed local archive
recommendation.body: Ship the documented branch-and-archive boundary, keeping paired nodes read-only and requiring the existing fresh checks plus explicit confirmation.
